newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. envoy leaving Mideast - Israel Radio.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy leaving Mideast - Israel Radio.

text.p: U.S. peace envoy Dennis Ross has told Israel he will leave the Middle East, having failed to break a stalemate in Israeli-PLO talks after 15 days of trying, Israel Radio said on Monday.

It said he had told leaders he would go home and return to the region when the sides needed his help to hammer out an agreement on the deadlock over the long-delayed Israeli troop pullback from the West Bank city of Hebron.
